_about: Public-domain Anna Shipton (1815-1901), English evangelical devotional writer, for the Word Hoard: 'Tell Jesus', Recollections of Emily Gosse (Philadelphia, 1868), The Secret of the Lord, Wayside Service, The Lost Blessing, Waiting Hours, The Watch Tower in the Wilderness, Hidden Springs (copyright 1881) and The Upper Springs and the Nether Springs (Nisbet, 1882), from Internet Archive scans. Most of her title pages carry no year. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
